fullPassage: As often as he could, after his classes were over and his work at the Footes’ was done, he returned to the university. Sometimes, in the evenings, he wandered in the long open quadrangle, among couples who strolled together and murmured softly; though he did not know any of them, and though he did not speak to them, he felt a kinship with them. Sometimes he stood in the center of the quadrangle, looking at the five huge columns in front of Jesse Hall that thrust upward into the night out of the cool grass; he had learned that these columns were the remains of the original main building of the university, destroyed many years ago by fire. Grayish silver in the moonlight, bare and pure, they seemed to him to represent the way of life he had embraced, as a temple represents a god.

Grayish silver in the moonlight, bare and pure, they seemed to him to represent the way of life he had embraced, as a temple represents a god.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

These columns were the remains of the original main building, __________ (destroy) many years ago by fire.

det.korean: 수동 분사구문 — 건물이 '무너뜨려진' → 과거분사 destroyed
det.analysis: the building (which was) destroyed by fire. 수동 과거분사

questions.passage: As often as he could, after his classes were over and his work at the Footes’ was done, he returned to the university. Sometimes, in the evenings, he wandered in the long open quadrangle, among couples who strolled together and murmured softly; though he did not know any of them, and though __________, he felt a kinship with them. Sometimes he stood in the center of the quadrangle, looking at the five huge columns in front of Jesse Hall that thrust upward into the night out of the cool grass; he had learned that these columns were the remains of the original main building of the university, destroyed many years ago by fire. Grayish silver in the moonlight, bare and pure, they seemed to him to represent the way of life he had embraced, as a temple represents a god.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오.

... and though __________, he felt a kinship with them.
(그는 그들에게 말을 걸지도 않았지만)

[조건] (1) did, he, not, speak, them, to를 모두 사용할 것
       (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 그는 그들에게 말을 걸지 않았다 → he did not speak to them (6단어)
det.analysis: 주어(he) + did not + 동사원형(speak) + to them. 일반동사 과거 부정.
det.tip: he(1) did(2) not(3) speak(4) to(5) them(6)

questions.wa: he did not speak to them
accept: he did not speak to them
